SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, u.email, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, NVL(u.push_enabled, 1) AS pushEnabled, NVL(u.role,'USER') AS role, u.family_id AS familyId, u.birthdate, u.sex, NVL(u.is_pregnant, 0) AS isPregnant, CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(u.is_admin)) IN ('Y', 'YES', 'TRUE', '1', 'ADMIN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isAdmin, NVL(m.breakfast_time, '07:30') AS breakfastTime, NVL(m.lunch_time, '12:00') AS lunchTime, NVL(m.dinner_time, '18:30') AS dinnerTime, NVL(m.bedtime, '22:00') AS bedtime FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_meal_times m ON u.user_id = m.user_id AND m.day_type = 'WEEKDAY' WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId}

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, u.email, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, NVL(u.push_enabled, 1) AS pushEnabled, NVL(u.role,'USER') AS role, u.family_id AS familyId, u.birthdate, u.sex, NVL(u.is_pregnant, 0) AS isPregnant, CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(u.is_admin)) IN ('Y', 'YES', 'TRUE', '1', 'ADMIN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isAdmin, NVL(m.breakfast_time, '07:30') AS breakfastTime, NVL(m.lunch_time, '12:00') AS lunchTime, NVL(m.dinner_time, '18:30') AS dinnerTime, NVL(m.bedtime, '22:00') AS bedtime FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_meal_times m ON u.user_id = m.user_id AND m.day_type = 'WEEKDAY' WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT user_id AS userId, login_id AS loginId, email, nickname, NVL(role,'USER') AS role, CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(is_admin)) IN ('Y', 'YES', 'TRUE', '1', 'ADMIN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isAdmin FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
UPDATE users SET profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE login_id = #{loginId}

#{userId} (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}) AS user_id, 'WEEKDAY' AS day_type FROM dual ) src ON (target.user_id = src.user_id AND target.day_type = src.day_type) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET breakfast_time = #{breakfastTime}, lunch_time = #{lunchTime}, dinner_time = #{dinnerTime}, bedtime = #{bedtime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, day_type, breakfast_time, lunch_time, dinner_time, bedtime, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (src.user_id, 'WEEKDAY', #{breakfastTime}, #{lunchTime}, #{dinnerTime}, #{bedtime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, day_type AS dayType, breakfast_time AS breakfastTime, lunch_time AS lunchTime, dinner_time AS dinnerTime, bedtime, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_meal_times WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN day_type = 'WEEKDAY' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, day_type AS dayType, breakfast_time AS breakfastTime, lunch_time AS lunchTime, dinner_time AS dinnerTime, bedtime, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_meal_times WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND day_type = #{dayType}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO user_meal_times target USING (SELECT #{userId} AS user_id, #{dayType} AS day_type FROM dual) src ON (target.user_id = src.user_id AND target.day_type = src.day_type) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET breakfast_time = #{breakfastTime}, lunch_time = #{lunchTime}, dinner_time = #{dinnerTime}, bedtime = #{bedtime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, day_type, breakfast_time, lunch_time, dinner_time, bedtime, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dayType}, #{breakfastTime}, #{lunchTime}, #{dinnerTime}, #{bedtime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
